title: First touch — AgilFence × AGIL Secure V11, end to end
notes: Source of truth for narration and English subtitles. `en` is the subtitle text and `say` the spoken form fed to TTS; `|` splits both into the same subtitle cues (each spoken chunk is also synthesised alone to time the split). `pre` is the silence (s) before the line starts. All times, distances and names are an illustrative scenario.

lines.en: 2:14 a.m. The north perimeter is quiet.|Kilometres of fence, wind across the runway,|and no one in sight.
lines.say: Two fourteen, a.m. The north perimeter is quiet.|Kilometres of fence, wind across the runway,|and no one in sight.

lines.en: At night, every fence alarm asks the same question.|Is it the wind? Or someone at the fence?
lines.say: At night, every fence alarm asks the same question.|Is it the wind? Or someone, at the fence?

lines.en: AgilFence makes the fence the sensor.|Fibre-optic sensors in one cable|feel a climb, a cut or a lift.
lines.say: Agile Fence makes the fence the sensor.|Fibre optic sensors in one cable|feel a climb, a cut, or a lift.

lines.en: It senses with light,|so electromagnetic and radio interference can't affect it.|It adapts to wind, rain and jet blast, to keep nuisance alarms low.
lines.say: It senses with light,|so electromagnetic and radio interference can't affect it.|It adapts to wind, rain and jet blast, to keep nuisance alarms low.

lines.en: Then someone climbs. Quietly.|The strain in the fibre rises above the wind,|and AgilFence pinpoints it: segment 5-14, to within a few metres.
lines.say: Then, someone climbs. Quietly.|The strain in the fibre rises above the wind,|and Agile Fence pinpoints it: segment five fourteen, to within a few metres.

lines.en: In the control room, AGIL Secure raises the alarm:|a system message, an alarm tone,|and a pin on the airport model.
lines.say: In the control room, Agile Secure raises the alarm:|a system message, an alarm tone,|and a pin on the airport model.

lines.en: It tops the incident list,|linked with the laser scanner's detection at the same spot:|one incident, not separate alarms.
lines.say: It tops the incident list,|linked with the laser scanner's detection at the same spot:|one incident, not separate alarms.

lines.en: Nurul clicks Locate. The map flies to segment 5-14|and lists the nearest cameras.|The fence alarm has already turned the closest one there.
lines.say: Nurul clicks Locate. The map flies to segment five fourteen,|and lists the nearest cameras.|The fence alarm has already turned the closest one there.

lines.en: One more click takes it live.|It zooms in on one person, and tracks them.|Fence, scanner and camera agree: it's someone.
lines.say: One more click takes it live.|It zooms in on one person, and tracks them.|Fence, scanner and camera agree: it's someone.

lines.en: On the command-centre video wall, the whole room sees one picture:|the live camera, the wide view,|and a replay from before the alarm.
lines.say: On the command centre video wall, the whole room sees one picture:|the live camera, the wide view,|and a replay from before the alarm.

lines.en: Then the airport's own procedure, step by step.|The system ticks the routine checks.|Nurul confirms it's real, and approves sending Arjun's patrol.
lines.say: Then, the airport's own procedure, step by step.|The system ticks the routine checks.|Nurul confirms it's real, and approves sending Arjun's patrol.

lines.en: Runway 02L is close,|so Nurul informs Airside Operations and the tower.|Duty manager Daniel takes command, and approves the police call.
lines.say: Runway zero two left is close,|so Nurul informs Airside Operations and the tower.|Duty manager Daniel takes command, and approves the police call.

lines.en: Cameras keep the intruder in view.|The patrol reaches them inside the fence line, well short of the runway,|and the police take over.
lines.say: Cameras keep the intruder in view.|The patrol reaches them inside the fence line, well short of the runway,|and the police take over.

lines.en: Nurul closes the incident, and Daniel signs off.|Every clip, decision and call is on the record,|with a report drafted for review.
lines.say: Nurul closes the incident, and Daniel signs off.|Every clip, decision and call is on the record,|with a report drafted for review.

lines.en: A location you can act on. A camera that's already there.|One picture and one procedure, every shift.
lines.say: A location you can act on. A camera that's already there.|One picture, and one procedure, every shift.

lines.en: AgilFence has been on Changi's airfield perimeter since 2011.
lines.say: Agile Fence has been on Changi's airfield perimeter since twenty eleven.

lines.en: AgilFence feels it.|AGIL Secure shows it: every sensor, camera and step, in one place.|Your team acts on it.
lines.say: Agile Fence feels it.|Agile Secure shows it: every sensor, camera and step, in one place.|Your team acts on it.
